Commentary.Commentary: Now then, there are around 14 overs to go today. Can Sri Lanka enter Day 4 unscathed? Will New Zealand pick a few wickets? We will find out in a while.

The Lankan bowlers did not look threatening at all. They did not receive any assistance from the wicket and they could not create any magic themselves. Lahiru Kumara bowled his heart out and he finished with a two-fer. The rest were quite inconsistent.

New Zealand entered their second innings with a lead of 74 and their openers then gave them the ideal stand with a 100-plus run stand. After Raval's dismissal, Latham continued and stitched two more handy stands with Williamson and Taylor. The opener went onto get his ton and with Nicholls built a massive partnership of 214. Henry too scored a century. Latham missed out on a double ton as he was dismissed just before Tea. Colin de Grandhomme post the break, smashed the bowlers to all parts of the ground, scored the fastest fifty by a Kiwi batsman in Tests, added a quickfire 124 run stand before Williamson declared.

New Zealand have finally DECLARED and they have set Sri Lanka a massive target of 660. A brilliant batting performance from the kiwis here. Yes, the wicket did ease out but take nothing away from the effort. All the batsmen contributed with two of them scoring daddy hundreds.

Once again it was all New Zealand in this session. Both Nicholls and Latham came out with an attacking approach. The two added a brilliant 214-run stand with the former getting to his ton and the latter eyeing another double hundred. That was not to be though as right at the stroke of Tea, Chameera got the opener, caught down the leg side.

The umpire though spots that and raises his finger. He then starts walking back again, disappointed but to a standing ovation from the crowd and the Kiwi players. THAT WILL ALSO BE TEA ON DAY 3!

Hello and welcome to Day 3 of the second Test between New Zealand and Sri Lanka at Christchurch. The lead is already 305 runs for the hosts and the question is, how many more will they like to add? Tom Latham is already set and he would like to score big for his side nonce again. On the other hand, the visitors, have a lot to ponder about. They need to pick wickets in clusters to make a comeback in this match. Lakmal has been very short with his lengths and he needs to come good. A lot will rely on him as he was the hero for Sri Lanka in the previous innings. The first session will be very crucial for both the sides. What is in store for us? Stay tuned to find out.

The lead is already a huge one and with a lot of time left, the Kiwis won't be in any hurry to declare. They will bat for as long as possible and probably bat the Lankans out of the game. Will we see the hosts continue the domination on Day 3 or will the visitors show some character and fightback? Join us to find out at 1100 local (2200 GMT, previous night). The Lankan bowlers tried their all. There was absolutely no assistance for either of the pacers or the spinner. Dilruwan Perera and Lahiru Kumara picked a wicket each but the visitors' bowlers never looked threatening.
